title: Click here for a good day
text:
It is a walk that allows you to freely explore the coast, adapting to the needs of the group under the supervision of the captain. The boat is well equipped and quite charming.  
Kay has been super friendly and I think we could not do this experience with someone better 👍🏻

title: Smooth Sailing
text: We had a great time.  We bought the boat out and enjoyed a sail to ourselves (my husband and I). The sail team was very accommodating and fun to sail with. Absolutely would do it again.
author: dougbW7794HO

title: Full day private boat tour
text: The owner and the captain were lovely.  the boat was very nice.  we had an amazing day.  I would recommend this to anyone looking to spend the day on the water.
author: joanellel2023

title: Fantastic day!
text: Fantastic full day up and off the boat. Sailing, swimming, snorkeling, sunbathe, having lunch, beautiful views,… Everything well prepared and feeling safe on board! Definitely recommended!
author: GrandTour25507412890

title: A PERFECT DAY
text: A spectacular experience. We celebrated a birthday on the sailboat with family and friends and we all enjoyed the day very much. Excellent treatment, Sandrine is pending all the details for a bespoke outing of the group and the Oscar skipper, a 10 in all aspects. Unforgettable!!
author: annamdaries

title: You have to prove it.
text: Sailing from the Port of Sitges, and bathing in Vilanova unforgettable. A unique experience with Oscar. Fun ensured between clean waters, aboard a sailboat with all the comforts.
author: anamei41

title: Spectacular crossing
text:
A real wonder. Everything went with us. Very good weather, calm sea, boat in perfect condition, enough wind to sail and a very professional captain. Undoubtedly an activity to repeat with them again. Recommended 100%.
Thank you SAILING TRIP SITGES
author: 528iv_nc

title: AMAZING, 100% RECOMMENDED
text: It was an excellent day, both for the treatment received and for the magnificent day on the sailboat. I recommend it 100% to everyone! Service from the morning was amazing and the treatment during the tour too. The measurements of covid were very safe and is a good alternative to enjoy any weekend or summer!
